We need to fix compilation errors.

Errors:

1. Missing MockitoExtension import. We can remove Mockito usage; not needed for tests. Remove @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class) and import. Or add dependency but easier to remove.

2. COLLECTING_FORMAT lambda: OutputFormat is generic interface expecting something? Need to see definition. Probably OutputFormat<T> has method T apply(Set<ValidationMessage>)? Actually in library, OutputFormat<T> is functional interface: T apply(Set<ValidationMessage> messages); So lambda should accept Set<ValidationMessage>. In code they used messages -> new ArrayList<>(messages). That's fine if messages is Set<ValidationMessage>. But error about cannot infer type arguments for ArrayList<> because messages is of type JsonSchema? Wait compile error indicates lambda parameter type inferred as JsonSchema (maybe because OutputFormat is raw?). Need to import correct OutputFormat generic type. Probably OutputFormat is from com.networknt.schema.OutputFormat. Should be generic. Use explicit type: OutputFormat<List<ValidationMessage>> COLLECTING_FORMAT = (Set<ValidationMessage> messages) -> new ArrayList<>(messages); Or use messages -> new ArrayList<>(messages) but need to import java.util.Set.

Also BOOLEAN_FORMAT lambda: messages.isEmpty() not defined on JsonSchema. Should be Set<ValidationMessage>. So same.

Thus define:

private static final OutputFormat<List<ValidationMessage>> COLLECTING_FORMAT = (Set<ValidationMessage> messages) -> new ArrayList<>(messages);

private static final OutputFormat<Boolean> BOOLEAN_FORMAT = (Set<ValidationMessage> messages) -> messages.isEmpty();

Need import java.util.Set.

Also need to ensure OutputFormat is imported: import com.networknt.schema.OutputFormat; (maybe already there? Not in code). Add import.

Remove MockitoExtension import and annotation.

Also need ExecutionContext constructor: they used new ExecutionContext(). That class likely has public no-arg constructor. fine.

Now compile.

Also need to adjust nullCheckProvider: Arguments.of(null, validNode, COLLECTING_FORMAT, "executionContext must not be null") etc. The format param expects OutputFormat<?>. Passing COLLECTING_FORMAT is fine.

But need to import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName (already used). Already imported.

Now final code.
